subject: LAB-040
check: Local commerce domain operations, refusals, request replay, lifecycle, and fixture parity
steps: On research through labr: swift test --package-path Packages/LabFeatures --filter CommerceWithoutTricksTests
Original product fixtures, deterministic injected simulator session ID, and fresh in-memory stores behind OperationService with GrantAuthorizationPolicy
Verified/unverified purchases, pending approval, offline restore refusal, refund, revoke, reset, unavailable/cancelled writes, denied/replayed requests, stale revisions, and reentrant mutations

outcome.detail: 18 tests in 4 suites passed. Unverified grants nothing; refused writes preserve simulator state; replays return the same receipt and recheck authorization; a stale receipt grants or clears nothing; refunded history cannot restore after later unsuccessful attempts. Reset preserves an unrelated imported record. The two local configuration products match the simulator fixtures.

limitations: Fixture execution on the research Mac (Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0 build 26A425); no App Store account or storefront used.

This record covers package tests, not a native UI walkthrough or a StoreKit transaction. The standalone StoreKitTest loader compiled but aborted without an XCTest runtime; its hosted replacement is recorded separately.
Physical devices, manual assistive-technology passes, and compilation with Xcode 26 / Swift 6.2 were not run.
